gloss: to bounce back; to rebound; to ricochet

definitions.gloss: to bounce back; to rebound; to spring back
definitions.explanation: For a physical object to bounce off a surface and return.

definitions.gloss: to backfire; to have a negative effect return
definitions.explanation: For negative consequences to return to the person who caused them, or for something to have an unintended rebound effect.

examples.japanese: ボールが{壁|かべ}に{当|あ}たって{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}ってきた。
examples.english: The ball hit the wall and bounced back.

examples.japanese: {弾丸|だんがん}が{装甲|そうこう}に{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: The bullet ricocheted off the armor.

examples.japanese: {石|いし}が{地面|じめん}に{落|お}ちて{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: The stone hit the ground and bounced back.

examples.japanese: {悪口|わるくち}は{自分|じぶん}に{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}る。
examples.english: Bad-mouthing others comes back to you.

examples.japanese: {無理|むり}な{値下|ねさ}げは{結局|けっきょく}{品質|ひんしつ}の{低下|ていか}として{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}ってくる。
examples.english: Unreasonable price cuts ultimately come back as a decline in quality.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}をだますと、いつか{自分|じぶん}に{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}ってくるものだ。
examples.english: If you deceive others, it will eventually come back to haunt you.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}る → {跳|は}ね{返|かえ}らない (negative)
・{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}る → {跳|は}ね{返|かえ}って (te-form)
・{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}る → {跳|は}ね{返|かえ}った (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {跳|は}ねる (to jump/splash) + {返|かえ}る (to return)

The combination means to jump/spring back.

COLLOCATIONS:
・ボールが{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}る - ball bounces back
・{光|ひかり}が{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}る - light reflects
・{自分|じぶん}に{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}る - to come back to oneself

TRANSITIVITY:
{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す is the transitive form meaning 'to repel, to bounce back (something)'.
